instruction.name: vfrstp.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, find the first negative 8-bit element in `b`. Write its index into the lane of `a` selected by the first element of the corresponding lane of `c` modulo 16, or write the maximum valid index plus one if no such element exists. Other elements of `a` remain unchanged.
